feature: CN receiving scan: flag must support partial quantities on grouped items (e.g. expected 100, scanned 60 → flag only the missing 40), and pressing Finish with unscanned items left should prompt the operator to confirm and auto-flag all remaining quantity as missing
reason: Scans aggregate per part, but current flagging works on whole groups only — there is no way to flag a shortfall qty, and Finish silently accepts orders where items were never scanned
remarks: Record only — not implemented yet. Related: CR-046 (expand grouped scans). CnFlagItemInput has no qty field (flag is whole-row); backend finalize already takes unresolvedAs:'missing' — the missing piece is the Finish-time prompt + per-qty flagging
